name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather in Santiago. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in simulation and modeling. After graduating, he gained experience at a local racing team, honing his skills in data analysis and simulator development.

Ricardo's approach to simulator engineering is meticulous and data-driven. He believes in creating a simulator environment that accurately reflects the real-world conditions, enabling drivers to push their limits and refine their techniques. He is known for his ability to identify subtle discrepancies between the simulator and track data, contributing to improved car setups. 

What distinguishes Ricardo is his unwavering commitment to accuracy and his talent for translating complex technical data into actionable insights for the drivers. He thrives in high-pressure situations and is always seeking new ways to enhance the simulator's realism.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always has a mate (tea) brewing at his desk.
